headline: Easy Wed executed clean — 44 load, HR capped as prescribed, legs ready for travel
summary: Solid, disciplined easy day: 50min flat seafront, avg HR 143 sitting right in the 138-148bpm target, cadence 83 (~172-176spm), RPE 2/10, feel 2. No strides, no Montjuic — exactly as written. This absorbs Tuesday's heavy 115-load session (39min Z4-Z5) cleanly rather than stacking fatigue before the flight. HRV 50 and sleep 6h20 this morning were both above the stop-rule thresholds (45 / 6h), so no cap was needed.
flags: CTL ramp sits at +2.3/wk today (50.9 CTL, up from 47.4 baseline 8 Oct) — within the 6/wk guardrail but watch it climbing into Saturday's 2h30/900m key session.
HRV has been sub-50 four of the last five days (42, 52, 42, 44, 50) despite normal sleep — worth tracking through the BCN-MXP travel day rather than treating today's 50 as a full rebound.
